	"gorm.io/gorm"

// 每个用例执行真实生成的 Repository，覆盖事务连接、缓存、扩展和复合主键。
func transactionDB(t *testing.T) *gorm.DB {
	t.Helper()
	var db *gorm.DB
	var err error
	ddl := []string{
		"CREATE TABLE items (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, amount NUMERIC(18,6), rate REAL, enabled BOOL, payload BLOB, attributes JSONB, created_at DATETIME, deleted_at DATETIME)",
		"CREATE TABLE notes (id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT)",
		"CREATE TABLE memberships (tenant_id INTEGER, user_id INTEGER, name TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, user_id))",
	}
	if dsn := os.Getenv("GORMPLUS_FIXTURE_POSTGRES_DSN"); dsn != "" {
		// 每个用例使用独立 schema；连接池的每条连接都有相同 search_path。
		admin, openErr := gorm.Open(postgres.Open(dsn))
		if openErr != nil {
			t.Fatal(openErr)
		}
		adminConn, openErr := admin.DB()
		if openErr != nil {
			t.Fatal(openErr)
		}
		schema := fmt.Sprintf("tx_%d", time.Now().UnixNano())
		if err := admin.Exec(`CREATE SCHEMA "` + schema + `"`).Error; err != nil {
			adminConn.Close()
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		t.Cleanup(func() {
			if err := admin.Exec(`DROP SCHEMA "` + schema + `" CASCADE`).Error; err != nil {
				t.Errorf("清理测试 schema: %v", err)
			}
			adminConn.Close()
		})
		u, parseErr := url.Parse(dsn)
		if parseErr != nil {
			t.Fatal(parseErr)
		}
		params := u.Query()
		params.Set("search_path", schema)
		u.RawQuery = params.Encode()
		db, err = gorm.Open(postgres.Open(u.String()))
		ddl = []string{
			"CREATE TABLE items (id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, amount NUMERIC(18,6), rate REAL, enabled BOOL, payload BYTEA, attributes JSONB, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ, deleted_at TIMESTAMPTZ)",
			"CREATE TABLE notes (id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT)",
			"CREATE TABLE memberships (tenant_id BIGINT, user_id BIGINT, name TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, user_id))",
		}
	} else {
		db, err = gorm.Open(sqlite.Open(filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "tx.db") + "?_journal_mode=WAL&_busy_timeout=5000"))
	}
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	conn, err := db.DB()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { conn.Close() })
	for _, statement := range ddl {
		if err := db.Exec(statement).Error; err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	dao.SetDefault(db)
	gormplus.Use(db)
	gormplus.ForceReplaceCache(gormplus.NewMemoryCache())
	t.Cleanup(func() { gormplus.StopSFCache() })
	return db
}

func TestBoundRepositoryCommitAndRollback(t *testing.T) {
	for _, rollback := range []bool{false, true} {
		t.Run(map[bool]string{false: "commit", true: "rollback"}[rollback], func(t *testing.T) {
			db := transactionDB(t)
			ctx := context.Background()
			repo, notes := NewItemsRepository(), NewNotesRepository()
			cached := query.Query().WithCache(time.Minute).Build()
			if count, err := repo.Count(ctx, cached); err != nil || count != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("initial count %d: %v", count, err)
			}
			var escaped ItemsRepository
			abort := errors.New("abort")
			err := gormplus.TransactionAsCtx(ctx, db, dao.Use, func(tx *dao.Query) error {
				bound := repo.WithTx(tx)
				escaped = bound
				if err := bound.Create(ctx, &model.ItemsEntity{ID: 1, Name: "inside"}); err != nil {
					return err
				}
				// 同一表连续写入也不能提前失效外层缓存。
				if err := bound.CreateBatch(ctx, []*model.ItemsEntity{{ID: 2, Name: "batch"}}); err != nil {
					return err
				}
				if err := notes.WithTx(tx).Create(ctx, &model.NotesEntity{ID: 1}); err != nil {
					return err
				}
				inside, err := bound.Count(ctx, cached)
				if err != nil || inside != 2 {
					t.Fatalf("tx count=%d err=%v", inside, err)
				}
				outside, err := repo.Count(ctx, cached)
				if err != nil || outside != 0 {
					t.Fatalf("original repository joined tx/cache invalidated early: %d %v", outside, err)
				}
				// 直接从全局 DAO 查，不传缓存，验证原仓储仍使用事务外连接。
				outside, err = repo.Count(ctx)
				if err != nil || outside != 0 {
					t.Fatalf("outside connection: %d %v", outside, err)
				}
				if rollback {
					return abort
				}
				return nil
			})
			if rollback && !errors.Is(err, abort) || !rollback && err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			want := int64(2)
			if rollback {
				want = 0
			}
			if count, err := repo.Count(ctx, cached); err != nil || count != want {
				t.Fatalf("committed count %d want %d: %v", count, want, err)
			}
			noteCount, err := notes.Count(ctx)
			if err != nil || noteCount != want/2 {
				t.Fatalf("cross repo count %d: %v", noteCount, err)
			}
			if _, err := escaped.Count(ctx, cached); !errors.Is(err, sql.ErrTxDone) {
				t.Fatalf("escaped transaction returned cached/default data: %v", err)
			}
			if err := escaped.CreateBatch(ctx, nil); !errors.Is(err, sql.ErrTxDone) {
				t.Fatalf("empty batch reused closed tx: %v", err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestBoundRepositoryReadsAndUpdates(t *testing.T) {
	db := transactionDB(t)
	ctx := context.Background()
	repo := NewItemsRepository()
	if err := repo.Create(ctx, &model.ItemsEntity{ID: 1, Name: "before"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	cached := query.Query().WithCache(time.Minute).Build()
	if _, err := repo.FindById(ctx, 1, cached); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	abort := errors.New("abort")
	err := gormplus.TransactionAsCtx(ctx, db, dao.Use, func(tx *dao.Query) error {
		bound := repo.WithTx(tx)
		if err := bound.UpdateById(ctx, 1, gormplus.WithUpdateColumns(tx.ItemsEntity.Name.Value("updated"))); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		checkName := func(name string) {
			t.Helper()
			one, err := bound.FindById(ctx, 1, cached)
			if err != nil || one.Name != name {
				t.Fatalf("tx detail %+v %v", one, err)
			}
			many, err := bound.FindByIdList(ctx, []int64{1}, cached)
			if err != nil || len(many) != 1 || many[0].Name != name {
				t.Fatalf("tx id list %+v %v", many, err)
			}
			single, err := bound.FindOne(ctx, cached)
			if err != nil || single.Name != name {
				t.Fatalf("tx one %+v %v", single, err)
			}
			single, err = bound.FindOneWrapper(ctx, nil, cached)
			if err != nil || single.Name != name {
				t.Fatalf("tx wrapper one %+v %v", single, err)
			}
			list, err := bound.FindList(ctx, cached)
			if err != nil || len(list) != 1 || list[0].Name != name {
				t.Fatalf("tx list %+v %v", list, err)
			}
			list, err = bound.FindListByWrapper(ctx, nil, cached)
			if err != nil || len(list) != 1 || list[0].Name != name {
				t.Fatalf("tx wrapper list %+v %v", list, err)
			}
			list, total, err := bound.FindPage(ctx, 1, 10, cached)
			if err != nil || total != 1 || len(list) != 1 || list[0].Name != name {
				t.Fatalf("tx page %+v %d %v", list, total, err)
			}
			list, total, err = bound.FindPageByWrapper(ctx, 1, 10, nil, cached)
			if err != nil || total != 1 || len(list) != 1 || list[0].Name != name {
				t.Fatalf("tx wrapper page %+v %d %v", list, total, err)
			}
			count, err := bound.CountByWrapper(ctx, nil, cached)
			if err != nil || count != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("tx count %d %v", count, err)
			}
			exists, err := bound.Exists(ctx, cached)
			if err != nil || !exists {
				t.Fatalf("tx exists %v %v", exists, err)
			}
			exists, err = bound.ExistsByWrapper(ctx, nil, cached)
			if err != nil || !exists {
				t.Fatalf("tx wrapper exists %v %v", exists, err)
			}
		}
		checkName("updated")
		if err := bound.UpdateMapById(ctx, 1, map[string]any{"name": "mapped"}); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		checkName("mapped") // 第二次读不能复用事务内部之前的 SingleFlight/缓存。
		where := func(w gormplus.IGenWrapper[dao.IItemsEntityDo]) { w.Where(tx.ItemsEntity.ID.Eq(1)) }
		if err := bound.UpdateByWrapper(ctx, where, gormplus.WithUpdateColumns(tx.ItemsEntity.Name.Value("wrapped"))); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		checkName("wrapped")
		outside, err := repo.FindById(ctx, 1, cached)
		if err != nil || outside.Name != "before" {
			t.Fatalf("early detail invalidation %+v %v", outside, err)
		}
		return abort
	})
	if !errors.Is(err, abort) {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	item, err := repo.FindById(ctx, 1, cached)
	if err != nil || item.Name != "before" {
		t.Fatalf("rollback detail %+v %v", item, err)
	}
	// 成功提交后必须清掉此前预热的详情缓存。
	err = gormplus.TransactionAsCtx(ctx, db, dao.Use, func(tx *dao.Query) error {
		return repo.WithTx(tx).UpdateMapById(ctx, 1, map[string]any{"name": "committed"})
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	item, err = repo.FindById(ctx, 1, cached)
	if err != nil || item.Name != "committed" {
		t.Fatalf("commit stale detail %+v %v", item, err)
	}
}

func TestBoundRepositoryDeleteVariants(t *testing.T) {
	for _, method := range []string{"id", "ids", "condition", "wrapper", "composite"} {
		t.Run(method, func(t *testing.T) {
			db := transactionDB(t)
			ctx := context.Background()
			repo := NewItemsRepository()
			if err := repo.Create(ctx, &model.ItemsEntity{ID: 1, Name: "before"}); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if err := db.Exec("INSERT INTO memberships(tenant_id,user_id,name) VALUES(1,2,'member')").Error; err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			abort := errors.New("abort")
			err := gormplus.TransactionAsCtx(ctx, db, dao.Use, func(tx *dao.Query) error {
				bound := repo.WithTx(tx)
				var err error
				switch method {
				case "id":
					err = bound.DeleteById(ctx, 1)
				case "ids":
					err = bound.DeleteByIdList(ctx, []int64{1})
				case "condition":
					err = bound.DeleteByCondition(ctx, tx.ItemsEntity.ID.Eq(1))
				case "wrapper":
					err = bound.DeleteByWrapper(ctx, func(w gormplus.IGenWrapper[dao.IItemsEntityDo]) { w.Where(tx.ItemsEntity.ID.Eq(1)) })
				case "composite":
					members := NewMembershipsRepository().WithTx(tx)
					if _, err = members.FindById(ctx, 1, 2); err != nil {
						return err
					}
					if _, err = members.FindByIdList(ctx, []MembershipsPrimaryKey{{TenantID: 1, UserID: 2}}); err != nil {
						return err
					}
					err = members.DeleteByIdList(ctx, []MembershipsPrimaryKey{{TenantID: 1, UserID: 2}})
					if err != nil {
						return err
					}
					if n, err := members.Count(ctx); err != nil || n != 0 {
						t.Fatalf("composite delete %d %v", n, err)
					}
					return abort
				}
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
				if n, err := bound.Count(ctx); err != nil || n != 0 {
					t.Fatalf("tx delete %d %v", n, err)
				}
				return abort
			})
			if !errors.Is(err, abort) {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if n, err := repo.Count(ctx); err != nil || n != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("delete escaped rollback %d %v", n, err)
			}
			if n, err := NewMembershipsRepository().Count(ctx); err != nil || n != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("composite escaped rollback %d %v", n, err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestBoundRepositoryInvalidTransactions(t *testing.T) {
	db := transactionDB(t)
	ctx := context.Background()
	repo := NewItemsRepository()
	raw := db.Begin()
	defer raw.Rollback()
	invalid := []ItemsRepository{repo.WithTx(nil), repo.WithTx(&dao.Query{}), repo.WithTx(dao.Use(db)), repo.WithTx(dao.Use(raw))}
	for _, bound := range invalid {
		if err := bound.Create(ctx, &model.ItemsEntity{Name: "bad"}); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("invalid tx silently used default connection")
		}
		if _, err := bound.Count(ctx, query.Query().WithCache(time.Minute).Build()); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("invalid tx returned cached count")
		}
	}
	if n, err := repo.Count(ctx); err != nil || n != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("original repository changed: %d %v", n, err)
	}
}

func TestBoundRepositoryKeepsBusinessExtensions(t *testing.T) {
	db := transactionDB(t)
	ctx := context.Background()
	repo := NewItemsRepository().(*customerItemsRepository)
	dependency := 42
	repo.dependency = &dependency
	err := gormplus.TransactionAsCtx(ctx, db, dao.Use, func(tx *dao.Query) error {
		bound := repo.WithTx(tx)
		if bound.Dependency() != repo.dependency {
			t.Fatal("WithTx lost custom interface/dependency")
		}
		if bound.(*customerItemsRepository) == repo || bound.(*customerItemsRepository).defaultItemsRepository == repo.defaultItemsRepository {
			t.Fatal("WithTx mutated shared repository")
		}
		return bound.Create(ctx, &model.ItemsEntity{Name: "custom"})
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if repo.daoTx != nil || repo.txScope != nil {
		t.Fatal("original repository was bound")
	}
}

func TestBoundJoinFunctionsAndWrapper(t *testing.T) {
	db := transactionDB(t)
	ctx := context.Background()
	cached := query.Query().WithCache(time.Minute).Build()
	type row struct {
		ID   int64
		Name string
	}
	abort := errors.New("abort")
	err := gormplus.TransactionAsCtx(ctx, db, dao.Use, func(tx *dao.Query) error {
		repo := NewItemsRepository().WithTx(tx)
		build := func(ctx context.Context) dao.IItemsEntityDo {
			return tx.ItemsEntity.WithContext(ctx).Select(tx.ItemsEntity.ID, tx.ItemsEntity.Name).LeftJoin(tx.NotesEntity, tx.NotesEntity.ID.EqCol(tx.ItemsEntity.ID))
		}
		// 即使显式要求缓存，两次泛型查询也必须看到本事务最新写入。
		for _, name := range []string{"first", "second"} {
			if name == "first" {
				if err := repo.Create(ctx, &model.ItemsEntity{ID: 1, Name: name}); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			} else if err := repo.UpdateMapById(ctx, 1, map[string]any{"name": name}); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			rows, err := FindItemsJoinList[row](ctx, build, nil, cached)
			if err != nil || len(rows) != 1 || rows[0].Name != name {
				t.Fatalf("join list %+v %v", rows, err)
			}
			rows, total, err := FindItemsJoinPage[row](ctx, 1, 10, build, nil, cached)
			if err != nil || total != 1 || len(rows) != 1 || rows[0].Name != name {
				t.Fatalf("join page %+v %d %v", rows, total, err)
			}
			one, err := FindItemsJoinOne[row](ctx, build, nil, cached)
			if err != nil || one.Name != name {
				t.Fatalf("join one %+v %v", one, err)
			}
		}
		// Wrapper 查询也必须从绑定仓储取主表连接。
		rows, err := repo.FindListByWrapper(ctx, func(w gormplus.IGenWrapper[dao.IItemsEntityDo]) {
			w.Where(tx.ItemsEntity.ID.Eq(1))
		})
		if err != nil || len(rows) != 1 || rows[0].Name != "second" {
			t.Fatalf("wrapper join %+v %v", rows, err)
		}
		return abort
	})
	if !errors.Is(err, abort) {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if n, err := NewItemsRepository().Count(ctx); err != nil || n != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("join transaction escaped: %d %v", n, err)
	}
}

func TestBoundRepositoryWithoutGlobalDAOAndPreparedStatements(t *testing.T) {
	for _, prepared := range []bool{false, true} {
		t.Run(map[bool]string{false: "ordinary", true: "prepared"}[prepared], func(t *testing.T) {
			db := transactionDB(t).Session(&gorm.Session{PrepareStmt: prepared})
			ctx := context.Background()
			// 事务仓储不应从全局 DAO 取连接或字段。
			saved := *dao.Q
			*dao.Q = dao.Query{}
			defer func() { *dao.Q = saved }()
			type traceKey struct{}
			ctx = context.WithValue(ctx, traceKey{}, "request-trace")
			err := db.Callback().Query().Before("gorm:query").Register("check_context", func(q *gorm.DB) {
				if q.Statement.Context.Value(traceKey{}) != "request-trace" {
					t.Error("query lost request context")
				}
			})
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			err = gormplus.TransactionAsCtx(ctx, db, dao.Use, func(tx *dao.Query) error {
				bound := NewItemsRepository().WithTx(tx)
				if err := bound.Create(ctx, &model.ItemsEntity{ID: 1, Name: "independent"}); err != nil {
					return err
				}
				if _, err := bound.FindById(ctx, 1); err != nil {
					return err
				}
				_, err := bound.FindList(ctx)
				return err
			})
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestDatabaseTypesAndPaging(t *testing.T) {
	db := transactionDB(t)
	ctx := context.Background()
	repo := NewItemsRepository()
	now := time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Second)
	amount := decimal.RequireFromString("12345.678901")
	item := &model.ItemsEntity{Name: "中文 ' 商品", Amount: amount, Rate: 1.25, Enabled: true, Payload: []byte{0, 1, 127, 255}, Attributes: datatypes.JSON(`{"name":"测试","count":2}`), CreatedAt: now}
	if err := repo.Create(ctx, item); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if item.ID <= 0 {
		t.Fatal("auto-increment ID was not returned")
	}
	loaded, err := repo.FindById(ctx, item.ID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if loaded.Name != item.Name || !loaded.Amount.Equal(amount) || loaded.Rate != 1.25 || !loaded.Enabled || !bytes.Equal(loaded.Payload, item.Payload) || !loaded.CreatedAt.Equal(now) {
		t.Fatalf("type round-trip mismatch: %+v", loaded)
	}
	var originalJSON, loadedJSON any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(item.Attributes, &originalJSON); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(loaded.Attributes, &loadedJSON); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(originalJSON, loadedJSON) {
		t.Fatalf("JSON changed: %s", loaded.Attributes)
	}
	if err := repo.UpdateById(ctx, item.ID, gormplus.WithUpdateColumns(dao.ItemsEntity.Enabled.Value(false), dao.ItemsEntity.Rate.Value(0), dao.ItemsEntity.Name.Value(""))); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	loaded, err = repo.FindById(ctx, item.ID)
	if err != nil || loaded.Enabled || loaded.Rate != 0 || loaded.Name != "" {
		t.Fatalf("zero-value update %+v %v", loaded, err)
	}
	if err := repo.CreateBatch(ctx, []*model.ItemsEntity{{Name: "second"}, {Name: "third"}}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	rows, total, err := repo.FindPage(ctx, 2, 2, query.Query().Order(dao.ItemsEntity.ID.Asc()).Build())
	if err != nil || total != 3 || len(rows) != 1 || rows[0].Name != "third" {
		t.Fatalf("offset paging rows=%v total=%d err=%v", rows, total, err)
	}
	// NUMERIC(18,6) 的大数精度有数据库差异，记录真实存储结果。
	precise := decimal.RequireFromString("999999999999.999999")
	edge := &model.ItemsEntity{Name: "precision", Amount: precise}
	if err := repo.Create(ctx, edge); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	loaded, err = repo.FindById(ctx, edge.ID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Logf("%s NUMERIC(18,6): 写入=%s，读取=%s", db.Dialector.Name(), precise.String(), loaded.Amount.String())
	if db.Dialector.Name() == "postgres" && !loaded.Amount.Equal(precise) {
		t.Fatal("PostgreSQL numeric lost decimal precision")
	}
}

func TestSoftAndPhysicalDeleteByDialect(t *testing.T) {
	db := transactionDB(t)
	ctx := context.Background()
	repo := NewItemsRepository()
	item := &model.ItemsEntity{Name: "soft-delete"}
	if err := repo.Create(ctx, item); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	cached := query.Query().WithCache(time.Minute).Build()
	if _, err := repo.FindById(ctx, item.ID, cached); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	abort := errors.New("rollback deletion")
	err := gormplus.TransactionAsCtx(ctx, db, dao.Use, func(tx *dao.Query) error {
		bound := repo.WithTx(tx)
		if err := bound.DeleteById(ctx, item.ID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if _, err := bound.FindById(ctx, item.ID, cached); !errors.Is(err, gorm.ErrRecordNotFound) {
			t.Fatalf("deleted row still visible: %v", err)
		}
		deleted, err := bound.FindById(ctx, item.ID, query.Query().WithDeleted().Build())
		if err != nil || !deleted.DeletedAt.Valid {
			t.Fatalf("soft delete not persisted: %+v %v", deleted, err)
		}
		return abort
	})
	if !errors.Is(err, abort) {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if loaded, err := repo.FindById(ctx, item.ID, cached); err != nil || loaded.DeletedAt.Valid {
		t.Fatalf("rollback deletion leaked: %+v %v", loaded, err)
	}
	err = gormplus.TransactionAsCtx(ctx, db, dao.Use, func(tx *dao.Query) error { return repo.WithTx(tx).DeleteById(ctx, item.ID) })
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := repo.FindById(ctx, item.ID, cached); !errors.Is(err, gorm.ErrRecordNotFound) {
		t.Fatalf("commit left stale detail: %v", err)
	}
	if n, err := repo.Count(ctx, query.Query().WithDeleted().Build()); err != nil || n != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("soft delete removed physical row: %d %v", n, err)
	}
	err = gormplus.TransactionAsCtx(ctx, db, dao.Use, func(tx *dao.Query) error {
		return repo.WithTx(tx).DeleteById(ctx, item.ID, gormplus.Delete().WithPhysicalDelete().Build())
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if n, err := repo.Count(ctx, query.Query().WithDeleted().Build()); err != nil || n != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("physical delete left row: %d %v", n, err)
	}
}

func TestNestedRepositoryTransactionsByDialect(t *testing.T) {
	for _, rollback := range []bool{false, true} {
		t.Run(map[bool]string{false: "commit", true: "rollback"}[rollback], func(t *testing.T) {
			db := transactionDB(t)
			ctx := context.Background()
			repo := NewItemsRepository()
			cached := query.Query().WithCache(time.Minute).Build()
			if _, err := repo.Count(ctx, cached); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			abort := errors.New("abort outer")
			err := gormplus.TransactionCtx(ctx, db, func(outer *gorm.DB) error {
				users := repo.WithTx(dao.Use(outer))
				if err := users.Create(ctx, &model.ItemsEntity{ID: 1, Name: "outer"}); err != nil {
					return err
				}
				if err := gormplus.TransactionAs(outer, dao.Use, func(inner *dao.Query) error {
					return repo.WithTx(inner).Create(ctx, &model.ItemsEntity{ID: 2, Name: "child"})
				}); err != nil {
					return err
				}
				var child ItemsRepository
				innerErr := gormplus.TransactionAsCtx(ctx, outer, dao.Use, func(inner *dao.Query) error {
					child = repo.WithTx(inner)
					if err := child.Create(ctx, &model.ItemsEntity{ID: 3, Name: "rolled-back child"}); err != nil {
						return err
					}
					// 真正的数据库唯一键错误；PostgreSQL 必须回滚到保存点才能继续查询。
					return child.Create(ctx, &model.ItemsEntity{ID: 1, Name: "duplicate"})
				})
				if innerErr == nil {
					t.Fatal("duplicate primary key unexpectedly succeeded")
				}
				if _, err := child.Count(ctx); !errors.Is(err, sql.ErrTxDone) {
					t.Fatalf("child transaction escaped scope: %v", err)
				}
				if n, err := users.Count(ctx, cached); err != nil || n != 2 {
					t.Fatalf("savepoint rollback failed: %d %v", n, err)
				}
				if n, err := repo.Count(ctx, cached); err != nil || n != 0 {
					t.Fatalf("nested tx published early: %d %v", n, err)
				}
				if rollback {
					return abort
				}
				return nil
			})
			if rollback && !errors.Is(err, abort) || !rollback && err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			want := int64(2)
			if rollback {
				want = 0
			}
			if n, err := repo.Count(ctx, cached); err != nil || n != want {
				t.Fatalf("nested result %d want %d %v", n, want, err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestPostgresRowLockBlocksOtherTransaction(t *testing.T) {
	db := transactionDB(t)
	if db.Dialector.Name() != "postgres" {
		t.Skip("SQLite 不提供 FOR UPDATE 行锁")
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	repo := NewItemsRepository()
	if err := repo.Create(ctx, &model.ItemsEntity{ID: 1, Name: "before"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	err := gormplus.TransactionAsCtx(ctx, db, dao.Use, func(tx *dao.Query) error {
		bound := repo.WithTx(tx)
		if _, err := bound.FindById(ctx, 1, query.Query().ForUpdate().WithCache(time.Minute).Build()); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		otherErr := gormplus.TransactionCtx(ctx, db, func(other *gorm.DB) error {
			if err := other.Exec("SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '150ms'").Error; err != nil {
				return err
			}
			return repo.WithTx(dao.Use(other)).UpdateMapById(ctx, 1, map[string]any{"name": "blocked"})
		})
		var state interface{ SQLState() string }
		if !errors.As(otherErr, &state) || state.SQLState() != "55P03" {
			t.Fatalf("FOR UPDATE did not block another connection: %v", otherErr)
		}
		return bound.UpdateMapById(ctx, 1, map[string]any{"name": "lock owner"})
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	row, err := repo.FindById(ctx, 1)
	if err != nil || row.Name != "lock owner" {
		t.Fatalf("locked update failed: %+v %v", row, err)
	}
}
